data.body: Fix implemented + verified GREEN. testing_mode=RED (new config-key path). Changes: (1) config-paths.sh reads review.non_reviewable_doc_dirs into CFG_NON_REVIEWABLE_DOC_DIRS and adds dso_sanitized_doc_dirs() helper with DSO_PROTECTED_REVIEW_DIRS filter (skills/hooks/agents/prompts/docs/workflows/.claude.skills/.claude.hooks/.claude.hookify/CLAUDE.md); (2) skip-review-check.sh appends sanitized dirs to _ALLOWLIST_PATTERNS after snapshot patterns, before the loop (force-review case still wins); (3) compute-diff-hash.sh appends :!dir/** to EXCLUDE_PATHSPECS symmetrically (closes the hash-asymmetry); (4) CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md documents the key + safety; (5) allowlist conf comment redirects hosts to the config key. New behavioral test tests/scripts/test-review-gate-config-doc-dirs.sh: 14/14 pass. Regression: test-skip-review-check (22), test-config-paths (28), test-compute-diff-hash* (40), test-review-gate-allowlist (8), test-check-allowlist-correctness (6), test-behavioral-equivalence-allowlist (39) all PASS. shellcheck clean.
